origin.description: Reverse the observations of a zoo series along its time order.
origin.details: The time order is reversed and the series is stored sorted by index again. For an already sorted index the values reverse and the index is unchanged. The series 1, NA, 3 becomes 3, NA, 1.
origin.value: A zoo series with the reversed observations.

translation.description: Reverse the observations of a zoo series along its time order.
translation.details: The time order is reversed and the series is stored sorted by index again. For an already sorted index the values reverse and the index is unchanged. The series 1, NA, 3 becomes 3, NA, 1.
translation.value: A Zoo series with the reversed observations.
translation.example:
import math
import sys

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/zoo")
from zoo.zoo_class import aggregate_zoo, ifelse_zoo, is_zoo, median_zoo, quantile_zoo, rev_zoo, xtfrm_zoo, zoo


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, (bool, np.bool_)):
        print("TRUE" if value else "FALSE")
        return
    if is_zoo(value):
        show(value.data)
        show(value.index)
        return
    array = np.asarray(value, dtype=float).ravel(order="F")
    print(" ".join("NA" if math.isnan(float(item)) else format(float(item), ".16g") for item in array))

show(rev_zoo(zoo([1, float('nan'), 3], [1, 2, 3])))
